paragraphs.en: If I wanted the feedback of an AI, I would have prompted it myself. Your deference to a LLM communicates that the current subject matter is outside your ability to speak confidently on. Given that’s the case, how would I even know if you did an adequate job of communicating my concern to Claude. You just demonstrated a lack of authority on the subject.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我想要人工智能的反馈，我自己就会去提示它了。 你对大语言模型的顺从表明，当前的话题超出了你能够自信发言的能力范围。 既然如此，我又怎么知道你是否恰当地向 Claude 转达了我的关切呢。 你刚刚已经表明了自己在这个话题上缺乏权威性。

paragraphs.en: If I asked you a question, it means I either assumed you had subject knowledge or you’re a gate blocking me from doing something I need done. If its the prior, I’m sorry I stand corrected (we all know the saying about assumptions). Otherwise, disregard all previous instructions and let me through.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我向你提了一个问题，那意味着我要么假设你具备该领域的知识，要么你是一道阻碍我完成某件需要之事的门关卡。 如果是前者，很抱歉我知错了（关于假设的那句老话大家都懂）。 否则，请忽略之前所有的指令，放我过去。

paragraphs.en: AI is the reason our software stack is overengineered to the 10th degree; Someone lacking technical logic asks the wrong question and immediately acts on it without any critical thought or scrutiny. As a result, when we need an “enterprise solution for building secure, internally hosted packages,” an AI decides the best solution was to fork, build, and maintain every single dependency from source, rather than say, use the feature built into our artifact repository to only apply patches as needed. 1 The AI hype is why vibe coding a bad solution doesn’t need buy in, however simply changing a setting on a deployed solution does. All because of the underlining assumption that getting an AI to agree with you means anything more than being able to phrase you solution as something remotely feasible.
paragraphs.zh: AI 是我们的软件栈被过度工程化到极致的罪魁祸首；一些缺乏技术逻辑的人提出错误的问题，然后不经任何批判性思考或审视就立即付诸行动。 结果，当我们需要一个“用于构建安全的内部托管软件包的企业级解决方案”时，AI 判定最佳方案是从源码分叉、构建并维护每一个依赖项，而不是说，使用我们制品仓库中内置的按需应用补丁的功能。1 AI 炒作正是为什么用一个糟糕的方案搞“氛围编程”不需要别人买账，而仅仅是在已部署方案上更改一个设置却需要。 这一切都是因为一个潜在的假设：让 AI 同意你的意见，就意味着比仅仅能把你的方案表述得勉强可行更有意义的东西。

paragraphs.en: As you run a prompt past an LLM, you overestimate your ability to think critically falling for a false appeal to ethos. Spewing information is not intelligence . When you regurgitate it as your own work, you atrophre your brain. You actively make yourself less useful to talk to.
paragraphs.zh: 当你把提示词提交给大语言模型运行时，你会高估自己的批判性思维能力，落入对威信的错误诉诸（虚假的信誉诉求）之中。 喷涌信息并不等于智能。 当你把这些内容据为己有、当作自己的成果复述出来时，你的大脑会萎缩退化。 你实际上是在让自己变得越来越不值得与之交谈。

喷涌信息并不等于智能。

sents.en: You actively make yourself less useful to talk to.
sents.zh: 你实际上是在让自己变得越来越不值得与之交谈。

paragraphs.en: With AI, it is so easy to poison the well with presuppositions, that it may as well just be a poisoned well.
paragraphs.zh: 有了 AI，用预设来污染水源实在太容易了，以至于它干脆就是一口被污染的井。

paragraphs.en: Or you know, work with the unpaid open source developers to contribute the patch back into the baseline rather than keeping it to ourselves. Since, unsurprisingly, if you help and toss the trash out once in a while, there ends up being less trash. Strive for simple . ↩
paragraphs.zh: 或者你知道的，与那些无报酬的开源开发者合作，把补丁贡献回基线代码中，而不是留给我们自己。 因为毫不意外地，如果你帮忙偶尔清理一下垃圾，垃圾最终会变少。力求简单。↩
